taglineZh: 提升截图与图片的分辨率、锐度和清晰度
taglineEn: Upscale, sharpen and denoise images and screenshots
descZh: 对图片和截图做放大、锐化与降噪处理，让低分辨率素材达到可用于演示和文档的质量。适合把模糊的产品截图、旧照片或压缩过度的配图修到能直接放进 PPT、README 和对外材料。产出是增强后的图片文件。
descEn: Enhances images and screenshots through upscaling, sharpening and denoising so low-resolution assets become presentation-grade. Use it when a blurry product screenshot, old photo or over-compressed graphic needs to go into slides, READMEs or client-facing documents. Outputs the enhanced image file.
demoCaptionZh: 同一张界面截图的增强前后对比，拖动分割线查看锐化与降噪效果
demoCaptionEn: Before/after comparison of a UI screenshot with a draggable divider showing sharpening and denoising

taglineZh: 模板驱动的单文件 HTML 图表与整页报告
taglineEn: Template-driven single-file HTML charts and reports
descZh: 从 Lupi、Basics、Glance 等真实模板库生成数据图表，也能按 12 套中英文模板生成整页 HTML 报告。给出数据和场合即可，默认 Mono 灰阶、按语义自动选彩色预设，双击就能打开，适合公众号配图、周报和对外叙事页。产出是无需构建的单文件 HTML。
descEn: Generates data charts from real Lupi, Basics and Glance template galleries, plus full-page HTML reports from 12 Chinese/English report templates. Give it data and a context; it defaults to a Mono grayscale system with semantic color presets and ships a double-click-to-open file, fit for articles, weekly reports and public storytelling pages. Output is a build-free single-file HTML.
outputZh: 单文件 HTML 图表 / 报告
demoCaptionZh: 一张 Mono 风格的百点构成图，每个点代表 1% 的付费新客来源
demoCaptionEn: A Mono-style hundred-field chart where each dot encodes 1% of new paying customers by channel

taglineZh: 一句话生成商家海报、菜单、请柬等设计物料
taglineEn: Turn one sentence into posters, menus and invites
descZh: 面向商家、老师和个体户的设计物料生成流程：先听懂需求、想创意概念，再出三个方向对比图供选择，然后按规格排版渲染。覆盖海报、小红书封面、通知、价目表、请柬、奖状、名片和 logo，中文由程序排字并自动检查溢出、对比度和广告法用语。产出多尺寸 PNG、印刷 PDF 和可复制的生图提示词。
descEn: A design-material pipeline for shop owners, teachers and solo businesses: it interprets the brief, drafts a visual concept, renders three direction boards to choose from, then typesets from a frozen spec. Covers posters, Xiaohongshu covers, notices, price lists, invitations, certificates, cards and logos, with code-set Chinese text and automatic checks for overflow, contrast and ad-law wording. Delivers multi-size PNGs, print PDFs and copy-ready image prompts.
outputZh: 多尺寸 PNG / 印刷 PDF / 生图提示词
outputEn: Multi-size PNGs / print PDFs / image prompts
demoCaptionZh: 一张奶茶店开业海报的大字堆方向示意，可切换三个配色方向
demoCaptionEn: A bubble-tea shop opening poster in the bold-type direction, with three switchable color directions

taglineZh: iPhone+MacBook 立体展架，屏幕嵌真实界面
taglineEn: CSS 3D iPhone + MacBook stand with live UI screens
descZh: 用纯 CSS 3D transform 搭建 iPhone 和 MacBook 的产品展架，屏幕里渲染真实的 HTML 界面而不是贴图，配钛金属边框、玻璃高光、地面反射和缓慢转盘动画。适合产品发布页、App 演示和设计稿展示。产出是 16:9 的单文件 HTML 展架页。
descEn: Builds an iPhone + MacBook product showcase with pure CSS 3D transforms, rendering real HTML UI inside the screens instead of screenshots, with titanium frames, glass lens highlights, floor reflections and a slow turntable. Use it for launch pages, app demos and design presentations. Output is a 16:9 single-file HTML showcase.
outputZh: 单文件 HTML 设备展架页
demoCaptionZh: 暗色展架上的 iPhone 与 MacBook，屏幕内是真实渲染的打卡应用界面
demoCaptionEn: iPhone and MacBook on a dark stage, screens showing a live-rendered habit tracker UI

taglineZh: 15 个高辨识度 React 交互区块，复制源码即用
descZh: 一组补齐 shadcn/ui 不覆盖的强视觉强交互区块：按钮开关、翻页进度、光学放大镜、空状态、贡献图、ASCII 背景、多帘预加载器等。当落地页或作品集需要一个有记忆点的组件、又不想引 npm 依赖时，直接复制带类型声明的 tsx 源码。产出是组件源码与配置，MIT 许可。
descEn: A set of high-visual, high-interaction blocks that shadcn/ui does not cover: toggle buttons, page-flip progress, optical magnifier, empty states, contribution graphs, ASCII backgrounds and multi-curtain preloaders. When a landing page or portfolio needs a memorable component without npm lock-in, copy the typed tsx source directly. Output is component source and config under MIT.
demoCaptionZh: 一个随指针泛起涟漪的 ASCII 字符背景，中央卡片带可切换的动效开关
demoCaptionEn: An ASCII character field rippling under the pointer, with a working motion toggle on the center card

taglineZh: GLSL 光线步进、流体与程序化生成的视觉技法
taglineEn: GLSL ray marching, fluids and procedural visuals
descZh: 整理自 MiniMax AI 团队的 GLSL shader 技法集，覆盖 ray marching、流体模拟、粒子系统和程序化生成。适合给落地页 hero 区、动态海报和视觉实验做实时渲染的背景或主视觉。产出是可运行的 shader 原型代码。
descEn: A GLSL technique collection curated from the MiniMax AI team, covering ray marching, fluid simulation, particle systems and procedural generation. Use it for real-time hero backgrounds, motion stills and visual experiments on landing pages. Output is runnable shader prototype code.
outputZh: 可运行的 GLSL shader 原型
demoCaptionZh: 一个实时运行的域扭曲 fbm 流体着色器，移动指针可扰动流场
demoCaptionEn: A live domain-warped fbm fluid shader that reacts to pointer movement

taglineZh: 把功能描述画成确定性的抽象 UI 风格 SVG 插画
taglineEn: Deterministic abstract UI-style SVG spot illustrations
descZh: 把一句功能描述变成安静抽象的产品插画：只保留界面最有辨识度的几何元素，发丝描边、占位条、单一强调色，从十二种固定版式里适配而不是新造构图。适合功能卡片、空状态、文档站和整套风格统一的插画家族。产出是可直接内联的确定性 SVG。
descEn: Turns a feature description into a quiet, abstract product illustration: only the most recognizable interface primitives remain, with hairline strokes, placeholder bars and a single accent, adapted from twelve fixed layouts rather than invented compositions. Use it for feature cards, empty states, docs sites and consistent illustration families. Output is deterministic inline-ready SVG.
outputZh: 确定性 SVG 插画（可成套）
demoCaptionZh: 四张同一家族的抽象功能插画：审批流、权限门控、数据同步与空状态
demoCaptionEn: Four illustrations from one family: approval flow, access gating, data sync and empty state

taglineZh: 浏览器 3D 场景、材质、控制器与后处理技法
taglineEn: Browser 3D scenes, materials, controls and post FX
descZh: 整理自 CloudAI-X 的 Three.js 技法集，覆盖场景搭建、材质、交互控制和后处理，用来在浏览器里做可交互的 3D 元素和体验。适合产品展示、数据三维可视化和创意落地页。产出是可运行的 WebGL 场景原型。
descEn: A Three.js technique collection curated from CloudAI-X covering scene setup, materials, interactive controls and post-processing for building 3D elements and experiences in the browser. Use it for product showcases, 3D data visualization and creative landing pages. Output is a runnable WebGL scene prototype.
outputZh: 可运行的 WebGL 3D 场景原型
demoCaptionZh: 一个可拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放的着色多面体与线框环场景（零依赖手写投影）
demoCaptionEn: A drag-to-orbit, wheel-to-zoom shaded solid with wireframe rings, hand-projected with zero dependencies
